title: Top Chicken, Sat 14 Nov: the record holder won with 201 likes, the lowest score of the window
summary: On Sat 14 Nov the game named @cee.wtf the day's winner with 201 likes. It is the lowest winning score of the window and ranks 47th of the 48 results in the fetched history, whose lowest is 185. @cee.wtf also holds the all-time record, 6,186, which the same result post repeats; 201 is 3.2% of it. The winning post is a top-level post from Fri 13 Nov 18:42Z: "i love when people think their laptop somehow uses less power per task than a datacenter". Fifteen minutes later @cee.wtf replied to it with a follow-up, and at 20:00Z @riziles.bsky.social replied with a variation on the sentence. At 15:25Z on Saturday, an hour and twenty minutes after the result, @dave.9000ish.uk quoted the result post: "@cee.wtf has really fallen off" (24 likes). @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com replied "cee will return and it will be glorious", and a minute later added that 201 likes is "a tough bet to make on the chicken market" (the market is on card games-top-chicken-market). The next day @cee.wtf posted "Gm top chickens" (card games-top-chicken-gm). This is the only winning post of the window that can be quoted (card games-top-chicken-standings).
